title: Jingle Bells · Piano nỉ
heard: v11: "tôi vẫn nghe tiếng lộp bộp" (I still hear the popping), on headphones, in the first and second verses; then, of the first verse's piano alone, its tune alone and its accompaniment alone: "tiếng lách tách đúng theo nhịp nhạc" (a crackle right in time with the music) in all three; of the piano mono, its strikes softened and its tone darker, only the darker one lost it
about: v12a: as 11a, played by sfizz with its voices' age mended (render: sampled.yml). sfizz 1.2.3 set a voice's age back to 0 after its first block (min for max), so its second block began as if the note had just been struck and played the first block's last sample again: a click in every note, 0-23 ms after it starts, its highs mostly (so the darker tone hid it). Every click sat on a 1024-sample block boundary; the boundaries after which no note started had none.
